what.text: This page follows refugees from Zimbabwe in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6632 Zimbabwean refugees, and South Africa hosted 29.3% of them.
After South Africa, the largest hosts are Ireland, Canada and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Zimbabwe from 1973 to 1979, with ZANU, ZAPU and the PF as opponents.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1978 and 1979, fall at the end of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1975 at 14720 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 197640, at the end of 1979.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
